decision_rule.fail_stop: either lane has no cap passing action, support, regret, certificate, all three uniformly applied case no-regression gates, and strict lane compute gates, or the mixed selected caps fail the strict aggregate gate
decision_rule.invalid: any source/roster/protocol drift, invalid native checkpoint certificate, trace monotonicity failure, incomplete work row, or postflight mismatch
decision_rule.pass: both lanes have a smallest qualifying raw native cap and their mixed aggregate qualifies; PASS authorizes implementation and new-seed full-trajectory confirmation only

development_boundary: This is a post-result and post-scout statewise development screen on the already observed 4,445 states. It reuses frozen occurrence weights and K4096 shadows, generates no tapes, and executes no policy trajectory. One raw native trace per state exposes the registered fixed-cap snapshots; the main decision uses each snapshot and its native cumulative work. A passing result authorizes implementation of the selected raw fixed-cap selector and a full-trajectory confirmation on new seeds only. Native exactness is reported diagnostically and is not a statewise-screen gate, so the new-seed confirmation must retain per-frame K4096 shadow-action checks.

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

selector_contract.case_compute_gate: candidate <= K4096 shadow in every WORK_GATE_FIELD, uniformly applied to all six cases; no case-specific exception
selector_contract.decision_selection_rule: run the native raw canonical selector once to the configured fixed cap and execute that cap snapshot
selector_contract.decision_work_rule: configured cap snapshot cumulative native WORK_FIELDS exactly once, with no exchange, bulk polish, old K144 rescue, or repeated primary search
selector_contract.first_checkpoint_equals_standalone_nativ: covered by focused selector unit tests rather than a second cold call on every registered state
selector_contract.lane_and_aggregate_compute_gate: candidate < K4096 shadow in every WORK_GATE_FIELD
selector_contract.native_score_and_canonical_exactness: reported but not a statewise-screen gate; fixed-cap shadow action identity, support, regret, certificate, and compute are gates
